statusMeaning: Baseline classification; action records final disposition.

rows.existingEvidence: Legacy gameVersion and reused v5-engine2 label; recipe and phase were independent
rows.action: Resolved: stamp measurement revision and immutable manifest reference at creation; actual engine/tracker/content/assets/configuration digests.

rows.analysisQuestion: Can configuration be recovered offline after refresh?
rows.existingEvidence: Config existed in the generated HTML; no retained export manifest
rows.action: Resolved: allowlisted immutable manifest embedded in the same CSV, persisted per run/segment; preserve old segments.

rows.analysisQuestion: Can historical bank contents be reconstructed from a CSV alone?
rows.existingEvidence: Original controlled authoring/build artifact and bank identifiers
rows.action: Keep question/answer text out of telemetry; retain reviewed generated HTML/authoring artifacts. Old unversioned saved questions remain unresolved.

rows.existingEvidence: Local question; private answer_evaluated and acceptedAttempt/legacy rules
rows.action: Preserve filters and exclude drafts, rapid guesses, metadata and duplicate transport/feedback from response counts.

rows.analysisQuestion: Which view, revision and commitment belong together?
rows.existingEvidence: runID + room/questionID ambiguous for repetitions; exam navigation exists
rows.action: Resolved: view-scoped presentationID, attemptID shared with private stream; exam revisits retain attempt, rapid rejection advances it.

rows.analysisQuestion: Which canonical option was selected after shuffling?
rows.existingEvidence: selectedIndex is displayed order; questionID alone cannot invert shuffle
rows.action: Resolved: carry original option ordinals through the exact existing swaps; no extra RNG call, text export or answer-verification change.

rows.analysisQuestion: Was this a lifetime-first learner exposure?
rows.existingEvidence: Existing firstExposure/priorExposureCount have bounded producer scope
rows.action: Document actual run/browser scope. No learner identity or cross-device history added.

rows.analysisQuestion: Was an artifact earned, owned, activated or applied?
rows.existingEvidence: Existing artifact award/ownership/action fields distinguish stages
rows.action: Keep award/action events; supplement submission-time effect snapshot, without duplicate reward events.

rows.analysisQuestion: What help/removal existed before this answer?
rows.existingEvidence: Runtime hint, artifact removal and mode-faded state; export insufficient
rows.action: Resolved: immutable hint/effect flags, canonical removed-option arrays and remaining count. Exam commitment reuses recorded draft support.

rows.existingEvidence: Existing stage and question IDs cannot reliably disambiguate repeated misses
rows.action: Resolved for newly observed ordinary miss to repair/bridge/retest; null for unobserved historical origin.

rows.analysisQuestion: Was a recommended resource offered or activated?
rows.existingEvidence: Existing report anchors and stable authored resource IDs
rows.source: report wrapper and delegated activation listener
rows.action: Resolved: observe existing offers/activations, omit raw URLs. Offer once per resource/run.

rows.analysisQuestion: Was feedback/PDF read or did it improve cognition?
rows.existingEvidence: Policy/engine identifies availability; clicks do not prove reading
rows.action: Remove unobserved duplicate private feedback_shown emission; keep legacy support. No dwell, PDF-load, graph-zoom or cognition inference.

rows.analysisQuestion: Can measured visible/hidden/focus time be interpreted?
rows.existingEvidence: Synchronized validated clocks and behavioral counts
rows.action: Retain units, overlapping focus, conditional nulls, exam aggregation, reset and readiness boundaries.

rows.analysisQuestion: Can retry duplicates and missing ranges be detected?
rows.existingEvidence: Private event UUID/sequence exist; local UUID exists but no creation sequence
rows.action: Resolved local sequence; preserve private IDs across retries. Validator detects duplicates/gaps, missing manifests and uncertain completion.

rows.analysisQuestion: Is queue/storage loss observable and can valid records progress?
rows.existingEvidence: Existing bounded queue silently evicted; poison batch could repeat
rows.action: Resolved counted overflow/cancellation/storage/rejection, required-manifest retention, singleton poison isolation and explicit acknowledgments.

rows.analysisQuestion: Can we prove completeness after total storage loss?
rows.existingEvidence: No surviving browser evidence can prove discarded history
rows.action: Report observed loss and absent completion only; no heartbeat or abandonment inference.

rows.analysisQuestion: Does private disabled collection prevent future queue replay?
rows.existingEvidence: Private disclosure existed; effective persisted control was insufficient
rows.exportLocation: Checkbox + build meta; local quality metadata
rows.action: Resolved real persisted switch, initialization/enqueue/flush/retry/page-exit guards, pending cancellation and refresh/re-enable tests.

rows.existingEvidence: Public derived adapter excludes transport and private identity
rows.source: Public sync and generated Composer browser tests
rows.action: Preserve zero remote telemetry requests and no new persistent browser identity.

rows.analysisQuestion: Does disabling erase previously accepted records?
rows.action: Cancel pending events only; owner decides retention, access and treatment of accepted data.
